snippet.title: Zombuds - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4443350/Zombuds/

The zombie apocalypse is here - time to make a profit. Loot, manufacture and distribute shady goods across a zombie-infested sandbox. Hire survivors, brainwash the undead, automate production and grow your empire in this open-world co-op sim.
